# Phase 0 benchmark contract

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

> **Historical artifact:** This records pre-hardening design evidence and does not define the current production method. See `docs/SCIENTIFIC_SPEC.md` and ADR 0004.

Schema version: `phase0-v1`

This contract is frozen before kernel selection. A benchmark implementation may be
optimized, but fixture definitions, reference score semantics, error aggregation, and
timing boundaries cannot change without incrementing the schema version.

## Required synthetic fixtures

Every run includes identity, 1%, 5%, and 10% deterministic substitutions, 5%
length-preserving deterministic indels, a 1,024-base circular coordinate offset, a
central inversion, a whole-sequence reverse complement, low-complexity blocks, tandem
repeats, and an unrelated control. All pseudorandom data and mutations use fixed seeds.

## Reference values

Each selected cell pair has two references:

1. Exact distinct canonical k-mer sets with ModDotPlot maximum containment and ANI
   transform.
2. Coordinated MashMap-compatible bottom-s sketches using the pinned MashMap hash.

MashMap is an approximation oracle, not a bit-for-bit expected result. Approximate
kernels are evaluated by absolute ANI error distributions against both references.

## Kernel report rows

One tab-separated row is written for each fixture and kernel with these columns:

`schema`, `fixture`, `kernel`, `sequence_bases`, `resolution`, `k`, `sketch_units`,
`build_ms`, `matrix_median_ms`, `bytes`, `cells`, `missing_cells`, `mean_abs_error`,
`p50_abs_error`, `p95_abs_error`, `max_abs_error`, `mashmap_mean_abs_error`,
`mashmap_p95_abs_error`, `forward_votes`, `reverse_votes`, `ambiguous_votes`,
`direction_correct_cells`, and `direction_tested_cells`.

Time covers sketch construction and the complete row-major matrix kernel separately.
It excludes fixture generation, exact/MashMap oracle construction, file I/O, and report
formatting. Bytes are owned heap capacity estimates, not process resident memory.

## Initial acceptance gates

No production kernel is selected solely on speed. On non-missing cells it must have
mean absolute ANI error no greater than 0.015 and 95th percentile error no greater than
0.035 against exact sets, with no systematic direction inversion. The MashMap delta is
reported independently. Repeat-rich failures are never averaged away by random-DNA
fixtures.

Chromosome-scale runs use the same schema and record their accession, checksum,
machine, browser/runtime, and cold/warm status in an adjacent provenance document.
